problem: Truthful Cuttlefish source has 38 independently observed semantic joint regions but ordinary mask intake admits at most 32 parts.
method: Retain every semantic region id, joint, source label, boundary and hash before explicit render grouping.

Require groups to partition the region inventory exactly, preserve source order, use one depth layer, be connected in both the anatomical graph and actual source-pixel adjacency, and number at most 32.
Build ordinary keyed parts from grouped labels using unchanged intake and exact keyed RGBA; no pixel is added, removed, recolored or assigned to another semantic region.
Compile a continuous source field from the original semantic owner labels and all semantic boundaries; use grouped ownership only to emit draw meshes and UVs.

Retain all observed joint influences with unchanged smoothing and solver profile. Do not call the existing splitter, which resets weights from draw-part owners; add a fail-closed guard for this incompatible operation.
Prove field coordinates, triangles and original semantic weights agree with an independently unpacked continuous-field control, and every semantic joint moves actual published painted geometry.

Require unchanged static, source conservation, source-size actual-rig review and serial native qualification before any reference admission. A continuous source field is not a hidden-surface reconstruction.
negativeControls: destructive legacy split after semantic compilation
